title: fedlora-partition-variance: code, configurations, and run artifacts for Partition Draws, Not Aggregators
description: Pre-registered 204-run study decomposing held-out-loss variance in federated LoRA fine-tuning into partition-draw, partition-by-method interaction, and training-seed components. Includes frozen configurations, grid definitions, the pre-registered analysis plan, the verifier, per-run metadata, and analysis outputs. Adapter weights are not included.
